requirement: In owner-token mode, protected access requires valid owner authentication and owner-cookie mutations require valid session-bound CSRF proof.
catalog_scope_correction: The existing general authenticated-mutation wording overclaims: bearer authentication and trusted peers intentionally do not require CSRF.

proof.action: Unauthenticated owner-mode GET / redirects to login and GET /api/status, /docs, and static authentication asset are denied.
Exchange owner token for browser cookies and access protected UI/API.
proof.observed: HTTP 200, session and CSRF cookies, cookie security attributes, no owner secret in cookies

proof.action: Issue session mutations with another session CSRF token, no token, wrong token, and matching token.
proof.observed: Cross-session, missing, and wrong proof return 403; matching proof returns 200 with successful vault rescan

proof.action: Authenticate bearer requests and exchange/logout browser session.
proof.observed: Bearer GET and mutation succeed; owner-session logout requires CSRF and subsequent protected access fails

proof.action: Read application activity after failed and successful owner exchanges.
proof.observed: Structured failure and success events including secure-cookie field, without owner secret

boundary_and_coupling.application: Real FastAPI production application and bootstrapped runtime with httpx ASGITransport; no app service mocks.
boundary_and_coupling.external_boundary: In-process ASGI HTTP, synthetic peer address and HTTPS URL; no live TCP, reverse proxy, browser, or TLS termination.
implementation_dependencies: OwnerSessionCodec produces deterministic time fixtures and verifies exact expiry outside HTTP; these are supplemental to the pilot requirement.
Cookie and CSRF header constants and structured activity event names are stable application protocol boundaries.
Vault rescan endpoint is the real mutation used to observe CSRF admission.
exclusions: No browser execution or visual behavior.
No WebSocket admission, deployment network topology, TLS or proxy trust semantics claimed by this pilot.
No requirement that bearer or trusted-peer mutations carry CSRF.
Fault tests are representative faults, not exhaustive verification.
